items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Start of period: invoice date 19.11.2026. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted, so the 30-day period begins 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days forward (November has 30 days) lands on 19.12.2026, which is the 30th day. 19.12.2026 is a Saturday. This is a private payment to a company, so under §270 Abs. 4 BGB the relevant place/Land for the §193 BGB weekend rule is the payer's own Land, Nordrhein-Westfalen. 19.12.2026 (Sat) is not a public holiday in NW regardless, and per §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 21.12.2026 (not a holiday in NW).
